title: Sefa (traveller, Lomaru, Onesa)
description: Persona: a 29-year-old from Lomaru, Onesa's capital, travelling in Taifafeki with a backpack and one phone. Has asthma and uses an inhaler; allergic to sulfonamides. Fictional.

persona.name: Sefa
persona.goal: Travel safely, and be treated properly if taken ill far from home.
needs: A clinic abroad that can trust and read their health summary
Something that works from the phone they carry
frustrations: Explaining their asthma and allergy in a language the clinic does not speak
